usageNotes: Removes a resource from HA management entirely — the VM or container continues to exist but will no longer be monitored or restarted by the HA manager. Requires `Sys.Console` at the root level, which is a cluster-wide privilege. Before deleting, ensure the resource is in a stable, non-migrating state; removing an HA resource while a recovery or migration is in progress may leave the cluster state inconsistent.

examples.summary: Remove VM 105 from HA management and purge it from any referencing rules

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the HA resource configuration for the specified VM or container, causing it to lose all high-availability protection (automatic restart, failover) with no recovery path short of re-adding it.
tips: You can use the bare VM/CT ID (e.g. '105') as a shortcut instead of the full 'vm:105' form.

The default behavior (purge=true) also removes the resource from any HA group rules that reference it, which can silently delete those rules if they had no other members — audit HA groups before running if rule preservation matters.
This call returns null synchronously; there is no UPID to poll, but you should verify removal with get_cluster_ha_resources or list_cluster_ha_resources immediately after.
